⚠️ Important Project Limitations

CAMPIVIO is a hackathon prototype demonstrating the concept of education opportunity discovery. Please note:

  • This uses demo/sample data, not live data from every college in India
  • Seat availability is reported and may not reflect real-time numbers
  • No guaranteed admission or scholarship eligibility
  • Always verify information directly with the institution
  • Data is gradually onboarded as colleges participate

How CAMPIVIO Works

A step-by-step guide to discovering your educational opportunities

01

Create Your Profile

Enter your academic details including marks, entrance exam scores, preferred course, location, and budget. The more details you provide, the better your matches.

02

Get Matched

Our rule-based matching system compares your profile against our college database. You receive a match percentage and clear reasons for each match.

03

Compare Opportunities

Review matched colleges side-by-side. Check fees, eligibility, seat availability, scholarships, and verification status — all in one place.

04

Plan Your Application

Use the document checklist to ensure you have everything ready. Track important deadlines so you never miss an application window.

05

Stay Updated

College administrators can update seat availability and information. You always see when data was last updated and its verification status.

Offline-First Design

Access your data even without internet

How Offline Access Works

CAMPIVIO can store the most recently synchronized college and scholarship information on the device. Students can continue browsing and matching using the stored data when internet access is unavailable. When connectivity returns, newer information can be synchronized.

📥

Data Synchronization

When online, college data is synced to local storage for offline access.

🔄

Smart Matching

The matching engine works entirely offline using cached data.

📤

Deferred Updates

Profile changes and preferences are saved locally and synced when online.

Note: This prototype demonstrates the offline-first concept using in-memory data. A production version would use service workers and IndexedDB for true offline capability.
